claim: In the matching retail DLL, MatchSEPlayer.Update (0x0600527A) is a parameterless instance method with an exact 51-byte body. It initializes a local Int32 index to zero and loops while signed index < 109. For each raw index, it reads rfs_se_wait_list[index]; when the value is greater than zero it takes the element address and replaces the value with value - 1, then increments the index. Values zero or less are left unchanged. The loop therefore visits exact raw indices 0 through 108 once per call. FACT-0060 pins the complementary writer: MatchSEPlayer.PlayMatchSE stores raw 2 into rfs_se_wait_list[seid] before dispatching the sound.
